diagnostics.message: The network-tier resource is configured for this project but does not wait for the Compute API activation resource. When Compute API is included in the module's services, Terraform could attempt this operation before that API is enabled.

The Shared VPC service-project association performs a Compute operation on this project but only waits for the VPC Service Controls resources. It should also wait for project service activation so the Compute API is enabled before the association is created.

This project-level Compute Engine setting can be applied before the Compute API is activated. When Compute is included in the module's service configuration, it should wait for project service activation.

The Shared VPC service-project association calls the Compute API but has no ordering edge to the project's service activation. It should wait for project service activation when Compute is enabled by this module.
Log-based metrics require the Cloud Logging API, but this resource does not wait for project service activation. It can race logging.googleapis.com enablement when that service is managed here.
Project log exclusions require the Cloud Logging API, but this resource does not wait for project service activation and can race logging.googleapis.com enablement.
Log scopes use the Cloud Logging API, but this resource does not wait for project service activation and can race logging.googleapis.com enablement.
Monitoring notification channels require the Cloud Monitoring API, but these resources do not wait for project service activation and can race monitoring.googleapis.com enablement.

Monitoring alert policies require the Cloud Monitoring API, but these resources do not otherwise wait for project service activation. An implicit reference to a managed notification channel, when present, does not itself order the channel after API activation.
